result.reason: The clause extends use to Affiliates and contractors and removes express at-will revocation, but it does not permit transfer to an M&A successor and does not establish that subscription licences are terminable only for uncured material breach; instead, it defers revocation and suspension rights to Section 13.3. It also does not provide perpetual, irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. The additions of worldwide scope, Documentation, service providers, and Authorized Users go beyond what was necessary and alter the original licence scope. Drafting defects include the duplicated section number and the unclear formulation “irrevocable (during the applicable subscription term).”
